consejos_sinergias: You asked for an anti-inflammatory approach: this plan leans on olive oil, avocado, nuts/seeds, and deeply colored vegetables and fruit.
Given the stress/sleep you reported, this plan leans on magnesium-rich sources (legumes, nuts, seeds, quinoa).
With a mostly sedentary job, this plan leans on higher-fiber sources (legumes, oats, whole grains, vegetables) to help with satiety and digestion.
advertencias_revision_humana: The client hasn't attached bloodwork, but there's a relevant unverified note: "Client mentions feeling tired frequently lately. Hasn't provided bloodwork yet; still need to ask for it at follow-up." — ask for it at follow-up so the diet can be modulated with real data.
mensaje_para_el_cliente: Hi Javier, here's your draft diet. No food is banned in this approach — amounts and context do the work. Judge it by whether you could still be doing this in three months, not whether it's perfect today. Anything that clashes with your day-to-day, let me know and we'll trade it for something equivalent. We're starting with a very mild deficit, close to maintenance, and high protein — the idea is to lose fat and build muscle at the same time, so don't expect the scale to move fast.
